annotations.title: Meet in the middle in Amsterdam

description: The point halfway between two or three Amsterdam locations and the nearest cafes, restaurants and bars from our directory: exactly the answer of our meet-in-the-middle page (same PDOK address lookup, same places). Give a postcode (1017 or 1017AB) or a street and house number with the city, e.g. "Dam 1, Amsterdam". Returns up to 10 places nearest the middle, each linking to its listing.

address_a.description: First location: postcode or address, e.g. "1091 GH" or "Dam 1, Amsterdam"

kind.description: Optional: only cafes, restaurants or bars. Default all three.
